test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Based on the classification of industries by raw material source, which option below is correctly paired?
solution: The correct answer is __**Petrochemicals - Mineral-based**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ • **Mineral-based industries** are industries that rely on minerals as their main raw materials. These include metals and non-metals derived from the earth through mining or extraction. • **Petrochemicals** are classified under mineral-based industries as they derive their raw materials from **crude oil**, which is a mineral resource extracted from the earth. • Petrochemical products such as plastics, synthetic rubber, and chemicals are produced using **refined petroleum** or natural gas as their base. • Other examples of mineral-based industries include **cement, iron and steel, aluminum**, and other metal-based manufacturing sectors. • **Incorrect classifications:** Tea and coffee are agricultural products and fall under agro-based industries, while woollen textiles are derived from animal fibers, categorizing them under animal-based industries.
